notes: rk-nsex Tier A repair wave, landing-blocker BL6 — additionalProperties:false enforced at every closed level of both record schemas. The L1 record carries an extra top-level reviewer_note and an extra hypothesis.confidence. Its review carries an extra top-level review_note, reviewer.author, checked.scope_complete, and checked.statement_complete.evidence. Before the repair, all six properties were silently accepted and the record became usable. The runtime validator now names every extra field in [record-malformed] / [review-malformed] and drops both documents rather than half-trusting them.
